# Appeal of Denial — Total Shoulder Replacement (CPT 23472)

**Member:** Emerson Brooks
**Member ID:** W628799962
**Payer:** UnitedHealthcare (Commercial/ACA), Iowa
**Denial date:** 2026-08-04
**Reference number:** POC-9AB63CFCDF-18778
**Governing policy:** Surgery of the Shoulder (2026T0556FF) — https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/policies/comm-medical-drug/surgery-shoulder.pdf

---

Dear UnitedHealthcare Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my request for a total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472), which was denied on 2026-08-04 (reference number POC-9AB63CFCDF-18778). My surgeon, Dr. Okafor, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I am asking the plan to reconsider its decision.

## The stated reason for denial

The notice states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I want to walk through what was actually submitted, and ask the plan to identify specifically what it considers missing, because the record already includes detailed findings addressing duration of symptoms, conservative treatment, imaging, and physical examination.

## What the plan's policy says, and how my records line up

The policy states:

> "Coverage Rationale Surgery of the shoulder is proven and medically necessary in certain circumstances."

and directs reviewers to specific sub-policies for medical necessity criteria:

> "For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the:"
> "o Arthroscopy or Arthroscopically Assisted Surgery, Shoulder o Arthroscopy or Arthroscopically Assisted Surgery, Shoulder (Adolescent) o Joint Replacement, Shoulder o Removal and Replacement or Revision, Joint Replacement, Shoulder Click here to view the InterQual® criteria."

Because my request is for a total shoulder replacement, the applicable criteria set should be "Joint Replacement, Shoulder." The specific text of that sub-policy has not been provided to me, so I am not able to see the exact criteria the plan applied to my case.

I note that the denial materials reference criteria describing "a full-thickness massive rotator cuff tear measuring ≥ 5cm and involving ≥ 2 tendons." My MRI of 2026-06-29 shows a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy — this does not match the ≥5cm, multi-tendon description in that excerpt. I raise this not because I believe I must meet that particular threshold, but because it suggests that excerpt may belong to a different clinical scenario than the joint replacement I am requesting. I am asking the plan to confirm which specific criteria set was actually applied to determine that my documentation was incomplete.

The record submitted with my prior authorization request includes:

- **Symptom duration:** 18 months of progressive shoulder pain, unrelieved by rest.
- **Conservative therapy:** 12 weeks of supervised physical therapy (16 visits, 2026-04-12 through 2026-07-05), documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- **Medication trial:** NSAIDs for 4 months with inadequate relief.
- **Injection:** corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-29, giving only 2 weeks of partial relief.
- **Imaging:** MRI dated 2026-06-29 showing a full-thickness supraspinatus tear (1.8 cm) with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- **Functional limitation:** inability to lift the arm above shoulder height or sleep on the affected side.
- **Physical exam:** positive provocative testing and pain-limited range of motion on the affected side.
- **Other factors:** no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, non-smoker.

The policy also notes:

> "Medical records documentation may be required to assess whether the member meets the clinical criteria for coverage but does not guarantee coverage of the service requested;"

I understand that submitting documentation does not by itself guarantee approval. My request is that the plan review the documentation above against the actual criteria for Joint Replacement, Shoulder, and let me know specifically what, if anything, is still missing.

## Request for the criteria applied to my case

The policy states that UnitedHealthcare "may also use tools developed by third parties, such as the InterQual® criteria, to assist us in administering health benefits." InterQual is licensed software, not a public document, but I have a right to see the specific criteria used to decide my case. Under ERISA and ACA appeal rules, the plan must provide, free of charge, the specific rule or criterion relied on for an adverse determination. I am formally requesting **the InterQual subset, edition, and full criteria text applied to my determination**, along with the complete text of the "Joint Replacement, Shoulder" sub-policy referenced in the medical policy above.

## What I am asking for

I am asking UnitedHealthcare to reconsider the denial of CPT 23472 for Emerson Brooks (Member ID W628799962), based on the documentation summarized above, and to provide the specific criteria — including the InterQual criteria — used to reach the original determination. If any additional records or forms are needed to complete the review, please let me know exactly what is required so my surg
